notes: ACCESS: horchow.com is fully retired - every path 302s to https://www.neimanmarcus.com/c/home-all-home-cat59040731?fromhc=true, so Horchow's catalogue IS the Neiman Marcus Home department and all links are canonical neimanmarcus.com URLs. Reached with curl_cffi impersonate='safari17_0' (DataDome passes it; desktop chrome profiles are 403'd). DataDome still issues intermittent 403s under load - handled with a 6-try backoff + session reset. robots.txt checked: no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web directive (only meta-externalagent is disallowed), so no Claude-specific block. TREE: recovered from the unprotected sitemap https://www.neimanmarcus.com/sitemap_category_1.xml.gz (3,629 category URLs; note the file is served UNGZIPPED and uses <sit:loc> namespaced tags) and cross-checked against the SSR left-nav JSON ("leftNav") on every PLP. Home has one Furniture department (cat47490757) with exactly three children - Dining Room, Living Room, Bedroom - each with its own leaf set; plus Outdoor > Outdoor Furniture (cat73650762), which is a leaf with no children. 13 leaves total. COUNTS: rendered listing header 'product-list__header__items' ("N items"). Per the one rule, every single number here was verified by full enumeration, not assumed: all 17 nodes (13 leaves + 3 room parents + the Furniture root) were paginated with ?page=N at 120 tiles/page to the last page and unique "id":"prodNNN" values counted. All 17 matched the header EXACTLY (e.g. Furniture root header 1,926 -> 16x120+6 = 1,926 enumerated; Coffee & Side Tables 321; Sofas & Sectionals 189). Product-ID fields were used, not anchor hrefs (hrefs undercount on non-ASCII slugs). HIERARCHY / NO DOUBLE COUNTING: pairwise product-ID overlap between the 12 Furniture leaves is 7 items in total (Buffet&Sideboards x Bars 2, Buffet&Sideboards x Chests&Consoles 1, Chests&Consoles x Dressers&Chests 3, Nightstands x Dressers&Chests 1) - genuine multi-assignment, not subsetting. Leaf union = 1,333 unique products. The Furniture root lists 1,926, i.e. 663 furniture products (mostly accent/drink tables, chairs, credenzas, desks, carts) are merchandised only at the root and are not filed under any child node; NM publishes no category page for them, so per the deepest-URL rule the root stays a grouping row and those 663 are not represented by any row. The three room parents are also not strict supersets of their own children (e.g. Living Room parent 845 vs children union 940), so no parent number was reused or summed anywhere. EXCLUDED after inspection: Home Decor and all 11 of its children (accents, wall art & mirrors, pillows, trays & vases, faux florals, picture frames, books, candles, desk accessories, curtains, pet beds) - no furniture nodes; Storage & Organization (120) - its only child is Men's Jewelry & Watch Storage Cases (94), i.e. boxes not furniture; Bath & Towels (towels/mats/accessories only, no vanity units); Bedding, Rugs, Lighting, Kitchen, Dining & Entertaining, Luggage, Tech & Games, Gourmet Food, Home Gifts and all Holiday nodes; Outdoor's siblings Outdoor Decor (171), Melamine Dinnerware (96), Planters & Garden Accessories (39), Beach Towels & Pool Accessories (17). Kids checked specifically for nursery furniture: the live Kids left-nav has no room/furniture node (Baby Gear & Essentials, 32 items, is diaper bags, bibs and stroller adapters). The sitemap's /c/kids-baby-gear-essentials-kids-babys-room-seating-cat81380760 (8 items: chaises, sheepskin benches, swivel/rocking chairs) is an orphaned legacy node - it is absent from the live nav and its own left-nav renders the internal Staging tree - so it was not emitted. Designer/brand furniture listings (Bernhardt Sofas, Hooker Furniture, Jonathan Adler Furniture, Century Furniture, Universal Furniture, Neuwood Outdoor etc.) were skipped as brand pages, and every /c/sale-* furniture node was skipped as a sale page, per the never-extract list. MINOR NOTE: Outdoor Furniture (76) is overwhelmingly outdoor chairs/tables/benches/loungers/sofas but carries ~4 inflatable pool floats; primary product type is still furniture so it was kept whole with the site's own exact count.
